title: Decision to stop briefing new legacy-program members on its history

tellings.quote: and and Dylan Borland kind of hinted at this or actually pretty direct about it with with you where he said uh that there was a a choice a decision made to stop briefing new people in the legacy program on the history of the program.

plain: Matthew Brown, described as a Pentagon whistleblower, speaks on Jesse Michels's podcast about the "legacy program", a supposed long-running secret effort tied to non-human craft. He says another man, Dylan Borland, told Michels quite directly that someone decided to stop telling new people in the programme about its history. If so, even the people inside it would not know how it began.
